documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported strong Q1 FY27 financial performance with record quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, achieving consolidated revenue growth of 52.1% year-on-year. Management revised its full-year growth outlook upward from mid-teens to high-teens, driven by robust domestic demand and strong growth across its advanced braking, aluminum lightweighting, and safety control cable segments. The company is accelerating capital expenditures, raising its annual capex plan to around Rs. 700 crore to fund a new plant in the South, and expects aluminum prices to normalize and improve EBITDA margins going forward. ASK Automotive Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, achieving highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year revenue growth guidance upward from mid-teens to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates an improvement in EBITDA margins as aluminum prices are expected to remain benign in upcoming quarters.
guidance.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

guidance.claim: The company is confident that it will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: The two-wheeler segment recorded a production growth of 22.8% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about the medium-term industry outlook supported by consumer sentiment and expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook, supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission, and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labor reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic that the growth momentum of the sector will remain in the coming quarters despite current challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite these challenges, we are optimistic that the growth momentum will remain in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM customers are carrying on with their original production schedules, which show a nice growth in this year as well.
demand_outlook.quote: As far outlook of the two-wheeler industry is concerned, our all our OEM customers they are carrying on with their original production schedules which shows a nice growth in this year also and none of the supplies have been affected by the raw materials or anything.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company needs to set up a new plant in the South on a war footing to cater to new orders.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will be investing around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue grew by 52.1% while EBITDA reached Rs. 164 crore representing 32.7% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with 32.7% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin stood at 12%.

margins_costs.claim: The company is 100% hedged on the casting line with a back-to-back pass-through with customers.
margins_costs.quote: In our this casting line, we have to see the absolute EBITDA, which as I have always explained, because there is 100% pass-through with the customer, back-to-back, we are fully hedged.

margins_costs.claim: Absolute EBITDA remained strong at Rs. 164 Crores compared to Rs. 123 Crores in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Absolute EBITDA remained strong at Rs. 164 Cr. against Rs.123 Cr. in Q1 FY26 .

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 was 12.1%, and for the full year FY26 it was 13.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier.

margins_costs.claim: The company aims to sustain the current level of EBITDA margins and improve gradually in subsequent quarters depending on industry growth and the geopolitical environment.
margins_costs.quote: Our aim is to sustain current level of EBITDA margins and continue our efforts to improve gradually in the subsequent quarters, depending upon the growth of the two-wheeler industry and geopolitical environment.

orders_capacity.claim: Confirmed orders for alloy wheels stand at Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and approximately Rs. 250 crore for the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant has increased from 60%-65% in the previous quarter to about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization, because we see the visibility for the Q4.

orders_capacity.claim: The Bangalore plant is currently running at near optimum capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Bangalore plant, which was our 18th plant, is running at near optimum capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: The technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been implemented at the Karoli plant and the first supply of High Pressure Die Casted Alloy Wheels has started.
orders_capacity.quote: Happy to share that the technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at our Karoli plant and 1st Supply of High Pressure Die Casted Alloy Wheel has started to our leading Japanese customer.

orders_capacity.claim: The third plant in Bengaluru has reached 90% capacity utilization, and all capacities there are full.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru. The Bangalore all capacities are full now.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects internal accruals to be sufficient for cash flow management alongside taking some external financing.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company will take term loans for machinery.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be taking term loan for machines.

capital_allocation.claim: Management remains confident that the debt-to-equity ratio will remain under control and not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: All internal accruals and free cash will be ploughed back into the company.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets leading to a sharp increase in aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, creating volatility in energy, commodity, and currency, and affecting the Indian economy.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from exports stood at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 compared to Rs. 147 Cr last year due to trade disruptions, higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, and logistics costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to operationalize the new plant in Bangalore before March of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Ford Motor exports are expected to be around Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and likely go up to Rs. 60 crore next year.
management_commitments.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

management_commitments.claim: Initial supplies for sunroof cables will start from H2.
management_commitments.quote: Initial supplies will start from H2, but next year, you will see substantial growth there.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from alloy wheels is expected to be around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr in FY27 and about Rs. 220 Cr in FY28.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
